new_result.statement: If an invertible physical cross block M0=US is updated by an arbitrary polar-favourable UH with H>=0, plus rank-r hostile L, residual R and dense tail T of operator norm delta, then s_q of the final cross block is at least max_p[s_{q+r+p}(M0)-s_{p+1}(R)]-delta. For q=5 a positive lower bound feeds the completed D5 receiver and yields a continuous density bound 5 sqrt(2e)/gamma.
new_result.essential_identity: M0+UH=U(S+H), so s_j(M0+UH)=lambda_j(S+H)>=lambda_j(S)=s_j(M0), without any commutation assumption.
new_result.literal_spectral_scope: For E_H=[[0,UH],[HU^T,0]], spec(E_H) consists of paired +/- eigenvalues of H; all magnitudes are free. Same-bank symmetric additions are unrestricted because the D5 receiver depends only on the original-coordinate cross block.

density_receiver.result: D5: s_5(M)>=gamma implies continuous density with ||p_Q||inf<=5 sqrt(2e)/gamma.
